The '''Admiralty''' was a ranking branch of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]], with [[Hiram Drayson/Legends|Hiram Drayson]] in its staff during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]]. It was possibly related to [[Fleet Command (New Republic)/Legends|Fleet Command]]. The Admiralty center was in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], near the [[Grand Hall]]. It was most likely [[Admiralty (Galactic Alliance)|reorganized]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
